policy_summary: Conditional coverage for newly diagnosed supratentorial GBM under this LCD; recurrent GBM and other indications listed as not reasonable and necessary
eligibility_or_criteria: Histologically confirmed newly diagnosed supratentorial GBM; maximal debulking if feasible then chemotherapy and radiotherapy; start within 7 weeks after last concomitant chemotherapy or radiation (whichever later); no RANO progression; KPS >=70; expected average use >=18 hours/day; reassessment with objective use/benefit evidence after 3 months
price_or_budget_condition: No price threshold listed in LCD
source_limitations: Applies to DME MAC jurisdiction policy; not a blanket statement for all US commercial and public payers
